blocks.markdown: **Penalty analysis.** Identify the exact offense, whether the data is PI or SPI, the mental state, and any aggravating circumstances (large-scale, public-officer status).

Unauthorized processing of PI: one to three years' imprisonment and a P500,000–P2,000,000 fine. Unauthorized processing of SPI: three to six years and P500,000–P4,000,000. Determine whether the information is PI or SPI and whether processing lacked consent or other legal authority.

Unauthorized access due to negligence: PI draws one to three years and P500,000–P2,000,000; SPI draws three to six years and P500,000–P4,000,000. Focus on negligent provision of access, not merely the existence of a breach.

Knowingly or negligently disposing, discarding or abandoning data in a publicly accessible area or trash collection: PI draws six months to two years and P100,000–P500,000; SPI draws one to three years and P100,000–P1,000,000.

Processing for purposes not authorized by the data subject, the Act or existing law: PI draws one year and six months to five years and P500,000–P1,000,000; SPI draws two to seven years and P500,000–P2,000,000. The focus is the purpose — lawful collection does not authorize an unrelated later use.

Knowingly and unlawfully breaking into a system where PI or SPI is stored: one to three years and P500,000–P2,000,000. Distinguish intentional or knowing intrusion from negligent access under Section 26.

A PIC that, after knowledge of a breach and the Section 20(f) notification duty, intentionally or by omission conceals the breach or its real extent: one year and six months to five years and P500,000–P1,000,000. The offense is concealment after knowledge of the breach and the duty to notify.

A PIC, PIP or their officials, employees or agents who, with malice or bad faith, disclose unwarranted or false information on PI or SPI they obtained: one year and six months to five years and P500,000–P1,000,000.

Unauthorized disclosure of data to a third party without consent, not covered by Section 31: PI draws one to three years and P500,000–P1,000,000; SPI draws three to five years and P500,000–P2,000,000. Separate PI from SPI and exclude malicious disclosure under Section 31.
A combination or series of the acts defined in Sections 25–32: three to six years and P1,000,000–P5,000,000 — a distinct penalty provision.

Where the offender is a corporation, partnership or juridical person, responsible officers who participated or by gross negligence allowed the crime are subject to penalty, and the court may suspend or revoke rights under the Act. An alien offender is deported after serving the penalty. Public officers or employees found guilty under Sections 27 and 28 may suffer disqualification.
The maximum penalty in the respective scale applies when PI of at least 100 persons is harmed, affected or involved.

Where the offender or responsible person is a public officer acting in the exercise of duties, accessory disqualification from public office for double the criminal penalty's term applies. Identify public-officer status and the official-duty connection.
Restitution for any aggrieved party is governed by the New Civil Code — the DPA refers the restitution issue to the Civil Code.
